offering_description.value: Sells product identification equipment, such as inkjet and laser coding and marking printers, to food, beverage, pharmaceutical and other manufacturers. Also sells water quality instruments, sensors and treatment systems to industrial customers and water utilities, mainly as equipment, consumables and service.

primary_products.value: coding and marking printers; consumable inks; water analysis instruments and sensors; UV disinfection systems; test reagents

primary_services.value: installation and maintenance; service contracts; instrument calibration

customer_segment.value: B2B: food and beverage makers, pharmaceutical and industrial manufacturers, environmental testing labs; B2G: municipal water utilities and government water agencies

end_markets.value: food and beverage; pharmaceuticals and life sciences; industrial manufacturing; water utilities; environmental testing

revenue_model.value: product sales: printers, instruments, UV systems and consumables sold to manufacturers and utilities; service fees: installation, maintenance and calibration for installed equipment

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: designs and builds printers, instruments and water treatment systems, sold to manufacturers and utilities; service provider: installs, maintains and calibrates equipment for existing customers

geography_served.value: global: Sells worldwide, with major operations in North America, Europe and Asia

specialization.value: diversified: two businesses: product identification (coding and marking) and water quality instruments and treatment

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to large industrial accounts and utilities; distributors / dealers: independent distributors and dealers in many countries

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: drinking water and environmental testing standards, plus food and drug labeling and traceability rules, such as EPA and FDA requirements
